profile.description: Infinity Capital Investments S.A. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in investments in asset management, expansion, development, start-up, growth capital, turnaround, and restructuring. The firm also specializes in asset management, project co-financing, and equity participation. It primarily invests in business and industrial products, financial growth, finance, banks, oil, gas resources, related services, real estate leasing, sub leasing, gas and energy transport, tourism, catering, leisure, pharmaceutical industry, financial intermediation, food industry, car, manufacturing and processing industry, electronical electrical engineering industry, consumer products, electronic related industries, communications, construction, financial services, and life sciences sectors. The firm seeks to invest in Romania. It seeks to take up majority and minority equity financing. It prefers to invest up to 5 years Infinity Capital Investments S.A. was founded on 1993 and is based in Craiova, Romania.
